title: The Storage Room Murder
motive_summary: Marcus Bell was being blackmailed by Ben Carter over a secret ledger.
overview_text: 08:12 — Ben Carter, owner of Hobbs Cafe, found dead in the cafe storage room by Isabella Reed. The cafe opened at 08:00. Several villagers passed nearby between 07:30 and 08:10. No one claims to have seen what happened. The morning can be rewound from 06:00.
